dedupe_keys.name: urejene kolesarske poti v mestni obcini ljubljana

description: Urejene kolesarske poti v Mestni občini Ljubljana is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA LJUBLJANA. The collection of well-maintained cycling paths in the City of Ljubljana contains line spatial data on well-maintained cycling paths with basic information on well-maintained cycling paths. Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA LJUBLJANA. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling routes in the City of Ljubljana" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA LJUBLJANA. Its keywords include kolo, MOL, kolesarske poti, kolesarske steze. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
